pedal: Boss NS-2 Noise Suppressor — the gain read directly: the signal into INPUT, a probe into RETURN (mono: OUTPUT)
note: The pedal off (its CHECK light off): the probe's reference. Cabling for the whole session: interface out 3 to INPUT; unplug the loopback cable from interface input 5 and plug that end into the pedal's RETURN (the other end stays in interface out 4); nothing in SEND; OUTPUT to interface input 2; the 9 V adapter. You will hear a steady three-note tone: that is the probe. With the pedal on it pumps as the gate works.

rig.note: Boss NS-2 on its 9 V adapter: the guitar DI dataset. Input from interface out 3; OUTPUT -> input 2; INST, AIR off, pad on, gain fully counter-clockwise.
